failure_summary.description: Some calls used an endpoint with the wrong input or result shape, reduced a requested check to a different target, or added overlapping calls that did not cover a distinct requested facet.
Calls had parameter placement, value casing, or requested-facet binding errors despite the endpoint schemas.
The answer wrapper had an extra closing tag, preventing the call list from being parsed.

patch.reasoning: The skill already covers schema placement, canonical values, and response formatting. The useful gaps to clarify are preserving the granularity of the requested target when choosing an endpoint and treating requests for multiple tools as a need for complementary coverage—not as permission to call every overlapping alternative.

edits.insert_after: - For overlapping endpoints, compare the exact input type and every requested output facet, not just the broad topic. If the user explicitly names a source or issuing authority, treat it as a constraint and prefer its matching endpoint over a different provider's similar result.
edits.content: - Preserve the granularity of the requested target when choosing an endpoint: for a check on a complete identifier, prefer an endpoint that accepts and checks that complete identifier. Do not reduce it to a component (for example, an email address to its domain) unless the user requested a component-level check or the schema requires that conversion.

edits.insert_after: - For multiple requested checks, use an endpoint that covers them all only when its documented scope supports that. Otherwise, make separate appropriate calls. Batch multiple items only when the endpoint explicitly supports batching those resources with the applicable options; do not pack multiple calls into a scalar parameter.
edits.content: - Choose the smallest complementary set of calls that covers the requested checks and facets. A request to use multiple tools calls for distinct, complementary checks; it does not require calling every overlapping validator. Add another endpoint for the same facet only when independent cross-checks or multiple sources are explicitly requested.
